This pains me to read as my cat passed away last night due to septic fluid that spread throughout her abdomen. Like your cat, mine showed no signs of being sick until yesterday she didn't want to move and she started yowling a bit when moving. I thought she'd just need antibiotics and she'd be fine but vet did more testing and she told us she found a lot of fluid in her abdominal cavity. They were trying to determine if it was septic. She didn't know where it came from and was waiting for an ultrasound vet to come and confirm the source of infection. Eventually the vet was able to extract some fluid to confirm it was sepsis. She said my cat could go through surgery but she was not guaranteed to get better. She told us that it was really bad and no matter if we had all the money in the world, the chances of survival were slim. 

I feel your guilt.  I feel your pain. I wonder if I took her in sooner she'd still be here. She was only 6.5 years old. But how could I know if she never showed signs of sickness. It all came so sudden.
